explore-on.title: Base current in, collector current out
explore-on.prompt: Turn up the base current until the transistor is fully on (saturated).
hints: Each microampere into the base lets 100 µA flow in the collector.
The circuit can't pass more than 12 mA.
explore-on.success: About 100 times the base current flows in the collector, until 12 mA: the transistor is saturated, fully on. The base controls the output current.

explore-cutoff.title: From fully on to fully off
explore-cutoff.prompt: The transistor is saturated. Now switch it fully off.
hints: No base current, no collector current.
explore-cutoff.success: Zero base current: cut off, no collector current. Saturated and cut off, on and off: a switch, worked by the base.
